title: Veg out Crew FPS
description:
You are Carro, the lone carrot or Brock the Broccoli on a mission to take back the Veg out World from all the moldy fruits and vegetables.

A throw back to the old classics of how the FPS originated. Get in and get blasting with all the weapons you can handle and the enemies you can blast! 

What you can expect:

• Over 20 different weapons, most with alternative fire modes too and more to come.

• Over 9 single player stages filled with up to 5 levels per stage, keeping you entertained for endless amounts of time! 

• A heap of different enemies per stage and building up to keep the entertainment and adrenaline pumping.

• Every stage has a different boss to keep you on your toes and wanting more at all times!

• A survival mode per boss where enemies keep on spawning and things just get harder each second you wait!

• Heaps more too, a fun, jam packed, crazy game!

A crazy bad Orange boss!

Some Tomato Blasting!

Blueberry sniping!

Apple gun madness!

Carrot bomb goes boom!

So what are you waiting for? Get in there as Carro or Brock and do some damage and blast your way through the Veg out World. 

Also, come join in on the discord and help shape our game. 

Happy Veg out Crew! :)
description_short: You are Carro, the lone carrot on a mission to take back the Veg out World from all the moldy fruits and vegetables. Make sure your locked and loaded for some fun, old school, retro, shooter action.
